title: Saudi Arabia Courts UAE as Military Partner for Renewed Houthi Operations
detail: Saudi Arabia is turning to the UAE as a key military partner as it prepares renewed operations against the Houthis. Riyadh is seeking to leverage UAE battlefield experience in Yemen, signaling a potential shift toward closer Gulf coordination after the UAE withdrew most of its forces from the conflict in 2019. The move indicates Saudi planners view the Houthi threat as requiring a more capable ground-component partner alongside Saudi air operations.

title: EU Aviation Agency Warns Airlines to Avoid Saudi Airspace Over Houthi Attack Threat
detail: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) issued a warning to airlines to avoid Saudi airspace due to the ongoing threat of Houthi attacks, escalating aviation risk across the region. The advisory reflects growing concern over Houthi ballistic missile and drone capabilities targeting Gulf infrastructure and civilian aviation corridors.

title: Yemen's Displaced Families Unable to Afford Three Meals a Day Amid Worsening Food Crisis
detail: Al Jazeera reports on severe food insecurity among Yemen's displaced population, with families unable to afford three meals a day amid ongoing conflict. The crisis highlights the deepening humanitarian emergency as displacement and economic collapse continue to erode food access across the country.

media.caption: Yemen's displaced families face worsening food insecurity
